input_policy: Read current Spec §13.13, applicable Design System, final manifest and rendered final product artifacts. Did not read author implementation scripts, quality reports, self-assessment or other semantic reports for this round.
actions: Captured 20 nominated/affected scenes at all three target viewports and inspected actual copy, controls, screenshots.
Inspected source-fallback card authorization and stable app keys through rendered DOM; independently exercised opening the shared work and rejoin-only revoked work.

Found enterprise-empty header stacked/cropped in all three viewports; reported before edits and preserved original screenshot/geometry evidence. Controller fixed product; reviewer did not edit product.
Repeated 60 screenshot/DOM captures against regenerated final artifacts; all five replacement legacy headers passed 15 own geometry checks.

Executed 36 browser interaction observations for directory search/sort/dedup, local-hidden restoration, enterprise-empty skills entry, distinct source/built-in skill titles, stop count and automatic completion/cancel/Reset.
Captured nine live progress bar targets and corresponding stopped-task counts and states.
Derived 24 fact/copy checks from actual rendered text; scanned all MVP scene DOM for retired common/five-item/home-add/remove copy, with no matches.
harness_note: Initial skill-name assertion counted an intentionally hidden built-in detail with same name. Corrected harness to count visible nodes only and reran; retained partial initial observations. No product defect inferred from hidden DOM duplicates.
limitations: Only browser prototype behavior was executed. Runtime/backend assistant task termination, live authorizations, payment and production Renderer fidelity were not tested.
